6.300 rsErrorLoadingCodeModule
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsErrorLoadingCodeModule is a critical error that will occur if a CodeModules.CodeModule listed in the
Report.CodeModules element fails to load.
